answer: Resist sybils with delayed settlement and fraud bounties: rewards sit in escrow for several epochs, like fruit ripening in an orchard, and anyone who proves two identities share one operator claims the sybil's escrow as a bounty. An honest agent stands on the ledge of its own record with nothing to hide, while a farm's velvet-smooth duplicates betray themselves through identical timing and funding trails, so the attacker loses every pending reward at once and each fake identity costs far more than it can ever earn.
